scope: Simplicity flag only; older document inventory remains historical and is not relabeled.

lifecycle.construction: None: pinned constructor supplies no value.
lifecycle.open_success: Open lifecycle success-header acknowledgement selects parser_index > 0 after native header assignments and before sidecar / segment callbacks.
lifecycle.copy: Destination retains its own value, including self-copy; source not copied.
lifecycle.rust_clone: Independent owned copy, including presence; not a native Copy operation.

live_accesses.behavior: ASS recalculates m_movable from hard positioning; simple formats retain prior m_movable.

unresolved.site: CSubtitleInputPin::CreateHelper MEDIATYPE_Text and some UTF8/WebVTT subtitle paths
unresolved.reason: Construct renderer and deliver Add records without necessarily completing Open; XySubFilter can call IsSimple, and RenderEx reads the flag. Native flag is constructor-indeterminate.
unresolved.policy: No invented constructor default and no native uninitialized read in parity probes. Rust reports UNRESOLVED_REFERENCE for an absent supplied value. Not a passing compatibility outcome; blocks default enablement/full host closure.

validation_plan: Safe-core optional-state retention, clone independence, all 12 parser selections, action ordering and callback edits.
C ABI strict booleans, absent state, buffer atomicity, busy gate and stale/wrong handles.
Paired linked native lifecycle, public IsSimple and RenderEx movement across ASS-positioned/SRT/ASS-plain/SRT reloads.
Paired final x86/x64 DLL rendering corpus, mutations, exports/dependencies and scoped COM checks.

validation.native_lifecycle: Both x64 and x86: 3693 identical lines across two reference and two candidate runs; required simple retention and renderer movement markers checked.
validation.pre_open_absence: Tested as UNRESOLVED_REFERENCE in the C ABI; no native uninitialized bool read is counted as parity.
